newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Zucchini stock rises on Bourse debut.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Zucchini stock rises on Bourse debut.

text.p: Shares in Italian electric cable manufacturer Zucchini firmed on the first day of trading on the Milan stock market.
At 1105 GMT, the stock was trading at 11,370 lire after opening at 11,150 in volume of over 230,000 shares against its flotation price of 10,400 lire per share.
"There is quite a lot of interest even from foreign investors," one trader said.
The Brescia-based firm, which has 48 percent of the Italian market, posted first half 1996 net profit of 2.8 billion lire on turnover of 31.8 billion lire.
